purpose: Project the target-blind V19AZ Bullet member ensemble onto the frozen V19H Chandra tangent grid as the three unsmoothed sufficient moment maps needed to test a long-wavelength collisionless-current or Reynolds-stress source, without selecting counterparts, fitting a propagation length, inferring absolute mass, opening lensing data, or changing gravity physics.

population.missing_bri_rule: Remain explicit in V19AZ completeness accounting but cannot be assigned a luminosity moment here; no luminosity is imputed.
population.transverse_velocity_rule: Remain unmeasured_not_imputed; V19BA constructs only line-of-sight current and stress moments.

grid.source: the primary HDU WCS and shape of the frozen V19H Bullet analysis mask
grid.deposition: four-pixel bilinear cloud-in-cell using zero-based floating WCS pixel coordinates
grid.boundary_rule: Every ensemble position must have all four cloud-in-cell neighbors inside the full grid; do not clip or renormalize a source at a boundary.
grid.analysis_mask_role: Report moment coverage inside the X-ray analysis mask but retain members elsewhere on the common full tangent grid.
grid.known_mask_overlap: Exactly member 66 lies outside the nearest-pixel V19H X-ray analysis mask in every frozen V19AZ draw; this is a precomputed parent-coverage fact, not permission to drop it.

projected_moments.ell_i: the unchanged V19AZ relative Bessel-I luminosity 10^[-0.4*(I-20)]
projected_moments.sufficient_statistic_role: For any later nonnegative long-wave operator H_L, the line-of-sight velocity-covariance source can be formed as H_L[Pi] - H_L[j]^2/H_L[rho]. V19BA does not select or fit H_L or L.

uncertainty_summary.per_pixel_outputs: Across-draw mean, population standard deviation, and all three pairwise covariances of rho_L, j_parallel, and Pi_parallel_parallel.
uncertainty_summary.sample_outputs: For every draw, store total deposited luminosity, signed current, positive second moment, luminosity-weighted mean beta, nonnegative global beta variance, RMS speed, and analysis-mask luminosity fraction.
uncertainty_summary.no_gaussian_approximation_claim: The mean/covariance FITS is a compact summary; the authoritative non-Gaussian positional and velocity distribution remains the V19AZ ensemble.

gates.failure_rule: Fail closed without clipping a member, widening the grid, changing deposition, dropping member 66, imputing missing BRI or transverse velocities, smoothing the maps, or selecting a theory parameter after seeing the moments.

claim_boundary: V19BA measures projected luminosity, line-of-sight current, and line-of-sight second-moment morphology; it does not detect a new gravitational field.
The second moment is a collisionless luminosity-weighted stress proxy, not gas pressure, total pressure, absolute energy density, or a three-dimensional stress tensor.
A future long-wave covariance requires a separately frozen propagation operator and universal scale; V19BA deliberately supplies unsmoothed sufficient moments only.
Member 66 is retained on the full grid even though the V19H X-ray analysis mask does not cover its location.
No lensing coordinates, inferred dark-matter maps, halo fits, gravity residuals, or Sigma constants enter this protocol.
